The pod logs appear to be unavailable since the container hasn't started yet. I have enough information from the pod status message to understand and resolve the issue. The error message from the storage array is very clear about the root cause.

Based on my investigation, I can now resolve this ticket with the findings:

input.note:
Root Cause: The clickhouse-2 pod is stuck in ContainerCreating because the storage array's host group (hg-k8s-prod) has reached its maximum LUN mapping limit of 512. The CSI driver error message indicates: "csi.corvane.io: CVN-4127: host initiator iqn.1994-05.com.redhat:ip-10-0-93-12 rejected by array cv-array-02: host group hg-k8s-prod reached max LUN mappings (512); retry after mapping cleanup"

Evidence: Pod clickhouse-2 status shows ContainerCreating with this explicit error message in the message field. The volume claim is Bound, and the node is assigned, but the device mount is failing at the storage array level.

Fix: Contact your storage administrator to perform LUN mapping cleanup on the Corvane storage array (cv-array-02). This is a backend storage infrastructure issue beyond Kubernetes' control. Once the storage team has cleaned up unused LUN mappings from the hg-k8s-prod host group, the pod will be able to mount its volume and transition to Running state. The retry mechanism mentioned in the error message should then allow the pod to proceed automatically.
